defect: The fix removes SkipDependencyRemoval and the DEPENDENCY_OWNS shortcut because AlterObject now completes the ownership link, and threads a transaction into the Print helpers.
reason: The skip logic added here was consistent with the then-deliberate uncompleted OWNS link; the repaired AlterObject problem lives in dependency_manager.cpp and the edits in this file follow from that redesign.

defect: The fix adds the reverse dependency link for owned entries in AlterObject and turns the AddOwnership system-entry asserts into an early return.
reason: The AlterObject logic was not touched by this change, and the asserts only became reachable after a later commit (975f01e) made IsSystemEntry also return true for internal entries.

defect: The fix gives PrintDependencies/PrintDependents a transaction parameter and drops a private helper that was added later.
reason: Adding a transaction argument to debug print helpers is an API refactor, not a repair of a defect in the declarations this change added.

defect: Sampling whole vectors in StringAnalyze skips the STRING_BLOCK_LIMIT check for unsampled vectors and can leave the analysis without any strings, giving an empty FSST symbol table.
reason: The fix moves the size check out of the sampling branch and forces sampling until a valid string has been seen, repairing exactly the lines this change added.

defect: The fix restructures UNPIVOT to build the unpivot lists in a subquery so the input columns are not projected through the UNNEST (issue 13552).
reason: This change only replaced alias assignments with SetAlias; the projection behaviour fixed later predates it.

defect: The fix replaces a default-constructed dummy schema for the MAP key_value struct writer with a real REPEATED schema and gives repetition_type a default value.
reason: The dummy_schema use was introduced by the later commit 3f0f5bc in column_writer.cpp; this header change only added the field, so the repaired defect is not in its lines.

defect: The new IN evaluation calls VectorOperations::Or(result, comp_res, result) with the output aliasing an input, which gives wrong results under g++.
reason: The fix copies result into a temporary before calling Or, repairing the aliasing call this change added; knowing that Or does not support in-place use needs its implementation.

defect: The fix restructures PreservedError::Throw to drop the else branch; both versions always throw the same exception.
reason: The rewrite is behaviour-neutral, so there is no defect in the Throw this change added.

defect: The fix replaces pow(10, scale) with an explicitly typed std::pow call for the Solaris R build.
reason: The pow(10, scale) line was moved unchanged from tools/rpkg/src/duckdbr.hpp, so the portability problem predates this change.

defect: The new Scan writes deleted-row indices with set_index into a default-constructed SelectionVector whose buffer is nullptr, a null-pointer write whenever a chunk has deletions.
reason: The fix allocates the selection vector with STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE and slices the result; that the default constructor leaves no buffer is only visible in selection_vector.hpp.

defect: The fix keeps the ART memory_size correct when nodes are swapped during merging by adding root ART pointers to MergeInfo.
reason: This change only replaced std::swap with swap; memory-size tracking during merge was added later, so the repaired defect is not in its lines.

defect: The fix adds root_l_art/root_r_art to MergeInfo for memory-size tracking during ART merges.
reason: MergeInfo as introduced had no size tracking to get wrong; the fix serves functionality added months after this change.

defect: The operator-state constructor pushes a fake constant group into the shared parent->groups, so any later state (e.g. a re-executed subquery) sees a non-empty group list, sets is_implicit_aggr false and breaks implicit aggregation.
reason: The fix moves the fake-group insertion into PhysicalAggregate::Initialize so it happens once per operator, repairing the mutation of shared operator data that this change put into the per-execution state.

defect: Database::Close dereferences the result of Connection::Unwrap(default_connection) without a null check, segfaulting when the object is not a live wrapped Connection.
reason: The fix, titled fix segfault, adds the missing null check on the unwrapped pointer in the code this change added.

defect: duckdb_get_list_size is declared with no parameter while the implementation takes a duckdb_value, a broken C API prototype (also copied into the extension API pointer type).
reason: The fix corrects the declaration to take duckdb_value value; the wrong prototype is in the lines this change added.

defect: The added DEBUG block asserts that the projection's own bindings belong to the referenced table's distinct group, which can never hold, so debug builds hit an assertion whenever the sizes differ.
reason: The same-day fix removes this assertion and replaces it with a non-asserting membership check, so the failing lines are the ones this change added.

defect: The fix applies clang-tidy cleanups: VectorInfo passed by reference, the duckdb:: qualifier dropped and a dead call removed.
reason: These are style and tidy changes, not a repair of a defect.

defect: Pipeline::IsOrderDependent dereferences sink unconditionally, but PipelineExecutor (added in the same change) calls it for pipelines without a sink, a null dereference.
reason: The fix adds the sink null check in IsOrderDependent and at its caller; the sink-less caller is only visible in pipeline_executor.cpp.

defect: The fix renames a test parameter and simplifies the test_all_types roundtrip query.
reason: Both the change and the fix are test-only edits; no product defect is repaired.

defect: Join key columns are compressed with each side's own statistics and only the compressed types are compared, so the two sides can be shifted by different minima (and a null compress expression is dereferenced), giving wrong join comparisons.
reason: The fix compresses both sides with merged statistics and checks for a null compress expression, repairing the logic this change added; the per-side offset is only visible in GetCompressExpression.

defect: The fix only moves the LogicalType declaration and whitespace in duckdb_param_logical_type.
reason: The fix is formatting; the identifier lookup visible in its context was changed by an intermediate commit.

defect: The fix casts the unsigned-branch debug assertion to uint64_t instead of int64_t.
reason: The signed overflow of (1L << 63) - 1 already existed before this change, and the int64 cast cannot change the outcome because calc_width < 64 bounds max_value, so this is a debug-assert cleanup.

defect: The fix lets the two range filters of Select_String_Between arrive in either order.
reason: This change only removed the valid_sel/count parameters; the assumption that tableFilter[0] is the lower bound predates it.

defect: TrySubtractOperator::Operation(signed_min_val, signed_max_val, signed_range) computes min - max instead of max - min, so the range is wrong and the compression to a smaller type no longer applies to non-constant ranges.
reason: The fix swaps the operands back; the reversed order is in the line this change wrote to replace max - min.

defect: The fix suppresses progress-bar printing during tests and skips the finish print when no progress was shown.
reason: This is a behaviour tweak; the printing logic was the same before this rename-only change.

defect: The fix extends the progress bar test with subquery cases and test mode.
reason: Both are test changes; nothing defective in this change is repaired.

defect: The fix adds parent_offset to the decimal source pointers for nested arrow arrays.
reason: This change only reformatted the code; the missing parent offset predates it.

defect: The internal header set_operation_type.hpp is included with angle brackets, which the amalgamation script (it only inlines quoted includes) leaves unresolved, breaking the amalgamated build.
reason: The fix converts it to a quoted include; that the angle-bracket form breaks the build follows from scripts/amalgamation.py.

defect: The fix moves the key cleanup so a break no longer leaks the key and requires that EXTRA_INFO was found.
reason: The leaking break came from an intermediate commit and this is test-only code; the test as added here freed every value.

defect: The fix moves the RowGroupWriteInfo constructors out of line and declares manager first to silence an initialization-order warning.
reason: The member-order mismatch already existed in the original constructor before this change, and it is a warning rather than a defect.

defect: Hard-coding the run-end loop bound to 2 leaves n_children used only in D_ASSERT, an unused variable in release builds that fails the warnings-as-errors CI configuration.
reason: The fix uses n_children as the loop bound again; the variable became unused through this change.

defect: Replacing new int32_t[n] with the variable-length array int32_t keys[n] is non-standard C++ that MSVC rejects, breaking the test build there.
reason: The same-day fix restores the heap allocation, repairing the VLA this change introduced.

defect: The fix changes RandomLocalState and RandomInitLocalState to the new FunctionLocalState type while resolving a merge.
reason: At this change init_local_state_t returned unique_ptr<FunctionData>, so deriving from FunctionData was correct; the fix adapts to an upstream API change.

defect: The fix makes the window GetData loop exit when no more tasks can be handed out instead of spinning until all tasks finish (issue 13602).
reason: The same busy loop existed before: the old local TryPrepareNextStage returned true when the thread had no task, so idle threads already looped until every task had finished.

defect: The fix adds a from_pandas parameter to TransformPythonValue so NaN is not turned into NULL outside pandas.
reason: The header only declares the function; the NaN handling lives in the implementation and the fix extends the interface.

defect: The fix drops the LogicalSubquery wrapper around the IN-clause chunk scan as part of reworking unused-column removal.
reason: This change only reformatted the code; the subquery wrapping predates it.

defect: The fix rewrites set-operation filter pushdown to resolve child bindings instead of wrapping the children in subqueries.
reason: This change only moved include paths; the pushdown design that was reworked predates it.

defect: ClearExpressions looks up ref_map with the post-erase index col_idx instead of the original index col_idx + offset, so after the first removed column it keeps or drops the wrong expressions.
reason: The same-day fix looks up col_idx + offset and remaps the references, repairing the index bookkeeping of this new file.

defect: The fix runs the index join inside a transaction opened before the appends and reports failure through a flag instead of REQUIRE in a thread.
reason: Both the change and the fix are test code; the race is in the test setup, not a product defect.

defect: In this file the fix only swaps Hash for Checksum in the debug range checksums; the deadlock fix is in caching_file_system.cpp.
reason: Hashing the buffer with Hash worked, so the edit here is a choice of function, not the repair of a defect in this file.
